text.tspan: The engine is fast: 2.1 s from face to match. The choreography is slow: the person learns the door is open 2.6 s after they were already verified.
Screens redrawn from the on-device recording (9 Oct 2026, on-screen clock 16:01:15–16:01:24); durations measured at 10 fps across two passes.

text.tspan: Source: on-device recording of the NOVA+ reader, 9 Oct 2026, on-screen clock 16:01:15–16:01:24 (10.4 s, two passes); timings measured frame by frame at 10 fps. Recorded screens are redrawn as low-fi replicas; no biometric imagery is reproduced. Lenses are a thinking tool drawn from public principles; no affiliation or
endorsement implied. All layers are editable vectors: Inter in Figma, SF Pro in production.
